ayahOccurrences.text: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ is in the derivative form: زاجِرات
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ز/ج/ر   z–j–r to scold, to rebuke
; to forbid, to restrain, to prohibit; to drive away.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 6 times in the Qur’an:
إزْدُجِر ʾizdujir 1 time; مُزْدَجِر muzdajar 1 time; زَجْر zajr 1 time; زَجْرةٌ zajratun 2 times and زاجِرات zājirāt 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
زاجِرات zājirāt [pl. of act. part. fem. زاجِرةٌ zājiratun] admonisher, one who rebukes, one who repels

(37:1–2) وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا by those ranged in rows, who rebuke reproachfully.

entries.label: زاجِرات
entries.definitionHtml:
زاجِرات zājirāt [pl. of act. part. fem. زاجِرةٌ zājiratun] admonisher, one who rebukes, one who repels

(37:1–2) وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا by those ranged in rows, who rebuke reproachfully.

entries.label: إزْدُجِر
entries.definitionHtml:
إزْدُجِر ʾizdujir [pass. of v. VIII] to be rebuked, to be repulsed, to be driven away

(54:9) فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is possessed!’ and he was repulsed.

entries.label: زَجْر
entries.definitionHtml:
زَجْر zajr [v. n.] scolding, reproaching, repelling

(37:1–2) وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا by those ranged in rows, who rebuke reproachfully.

entries.label: زَجْرةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
زَجْرةٌ zajratun [unit. n.] a chasing away; a scolding; a cry

(37:19) فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ it is but a single call and–lo and behold!–they will be [alive] looking around.

entries.label: مُزْدَجَر
entries.definitionHtml:
مُزْدَجَر muzdajar [v. n.; n. of place] deterring, restraining; lesson to be learned

(54:4) وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الأَنْبَاءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ and there have come to them some tidings [of past generations] in which [they should find] a deterrent.
